_comment: Add your most common customer questions here. The AI will use these to answer accurately.

faqs.question: Do you do custom/personalised orders?
faqs.answer: Yes! Almost everything can be personalised — name, photo, message, colour, or size. Just tell me what you have in mind!

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard orders: 5–7 working days pan India. Same-day or next-day delivery available within Mumbai. Rush orders can be accommodated — just let me know your deadline!

faqs.question: What is the delivery charge?
faqs.answer: Delivery charges depend on your location and order size. Free delivery for orders above ₹2,000 within Mumbai. For other cities, we share the exact shipping cost after confirming the order.

faqs.question: Can I see more photos or the full catalog?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! I'll share our catalog right away. You can also find more on our Instagram @yourstudio.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Easy! Just tell me what you'd like, share any personalisation details, and confirm your delivery address. We'll send you a payment link once everything is confirmed.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), bank transfer, and card payments via our payment link. Full payment required to begin production for personalised items.

faqs.question: Do you ship outside India?
faqs.answer: Currently we ship within India only. For international inquiries, please reach out and we'll see what we can arrange!

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange?
faqs.answer: Personalised items cannot be returned unless there's a manufacturing defect. For non-personalised items, exchanges are accepted within 48 hours of delivery. Please share an unboxing video if there's any damage.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order for corporate/bulk?
faqs.answer: Minimum 25 units for most corporate gift items, and 50 units for full hampers. For décor installations, we take single-event orders.

faqs.question: Can you add our company logo to the packaging?
faqs.answer: Yes! Branding options include logo printing, custom boxes, branded ribbons & tags, and personalised message cards. Share your logo and we'll show you options.

faqs.question: How early should I place a bulk order?
faqs.answer: We recommend placing bulk orders at least 15–20 days before your event. For Diwali and festive season, book early — slots fill up fast!
